body:
## What

Lands `fn:atomic-equal` at the frozen `XPath40` level (not experimental): the op:same-key map-key rule exposed as a function (F&O 4.0 §2.2.1, Issue 221/PR 319, February 2023), plus two 4.0 parser companions. qt4tests gate gains **fn-atomic-equal + fn-while-do → 212 sets**.

- **`fn:atomic-equal($value1, $value2)`** — delegates to the existing `XdmValueEqualityComparer` (the same semantics source map construction/lookup uses): string/`xs:anyURI`/`xs:untypedAtomic` by codepoint (never by collation — atomic-equal-002), numerics by exact mathematical magnitude (NaN = NaN, +0 = −0, `1.1` ≠ `1.1e0`), date/time/g* only when timezone presence matches (implicit timezone never used), QName by {namespace URI, local name}, durations by normalized totals. The one 4.0 delta over 3.1 map keys: **PR2168** makes `xs:hexBinary`/`xs:base64Binary` mutually comparable by decoded octets. Signature `xs:anyAtomicType` (exactly one item — empty/multi → XPTY0004, nodes atomized).
- **Parser companions (4.0)**: quantifier keywords double as function names in arrow targets (`$seq => every()` ≡ `fn:every($seq)`); `if` accepts braced `EnclosedExpr` branches (`if (C) { X } else { Y }`) with `else` omittable for a braced then (false → empty sequence; keyword form without else stays XPST0003).
- **fn-while-do promotion**: its last exploratory failure was fixed incidentally by earlier engine work — verified 30/0/0, promoted without code change.

## Verification

- `dotnet test Bosak.sln -c Release`: all green, **3,501 passed / 0 failed** (+24: 21 new `AtomicEqualTests`, 3 VersionGate rows).
- QT3 gate: **31,142/0/679**, exit 0 — unchanged.
- XSLT smoke (`catalog.xml mode`): **162/0/26**.
- qt4tests per-set: fn-atomic-equal **29/0/1** (skip = XQ-only dependency), fn-while-do **30/0/0**.
- qt4tests gate-only (`BOSAK_QT4_GATE_ONLY=1`) with the final binary: **7,562/0/1,833, exit 0, 212 gated sets** (+59 passes over the 210-set gate = 29 + 30, reconciles exactly).

## Dev note

First gate-only attempt after `dotnet test` ran a stale `Bosak.XPath.Parser.dll` (test-host build cache) and reported 154 phantom else-branch parse failures; an explicit harness rebuild produced the green run above. Documented in the handover quirks.
title: REQ-123 fn:atomic-equal slice: F&O 4.0 §2.2.1 map-key equality exposed (frozen level) + 4.0 parser companions — gate gains two sets → 212
